About ShopMarginLab & Our 2026 Verification Methodology

ShopMarginLab was built to solve one recurring problem for independent US e-commerce sellers, Print-on-Demand creators, and resellers: headline marketplace fees almost never match what actually disappears from your payout statement.

1. Who Builds and Maintains ShopMarginLab

ShopMarginLab is founded and maintained by Nguyen Chi Thanh (Founder & E-Commerce Unit-Economics Researcher). Every calculator, multi-channel comparison model, and unlocked Excel workbook is authored specifically for small-business unit economics—focusing on the real edge cases that silently drain margin: fees applied to buyer-paid shipping and state sales tax, mandatory Etsy Offsite Ads thresholds, TikTok creator affiliate stacking, and US Schedule-C tax set-asides.

Have a correction, fee update, or feature request? Email us directly at thanh@shopmarginlab.com. We audit reported marketplace schedule changes within 72 hours.

2. Our 5-Step 2026 Fee Verification Process

  1. Primary Documentation Audit: Every rate is checked directly against official US marketplace fee schedules and IRS Schedule-C publications (listed below), never copied blindly from outdated blog posts.
  2. Tax & Shipping Fee-Basis Normalization: We explicitly model platform-specific nuances—such as eBay, Whatnot, and Depop applying processing/FVF percentages to state sales tax, versus Poshmark charging strictly on item sale price.
  3. Automated Zero-NaN Formula Testing: Before any deployment goes live, our automated test suite executes every JavaScript calculation function across default inputs and every dropdown tier to confirm zero broken formulas or edge-case errors.
  4. 100% Client-Side Privacy: All calculator math executes locally inside your browser. Your store prices, COGS, and revenue figures are never sent to or stored on our servers.
  5. Transparent Scope & YMYL Boundaries: Our US Schedule-C tax estimators and financial workbooks are strictly for cash-flow planning and education—we clearly note where sellers should consult a licensed CPA (e.g., S-Corp elections, inventory accounting methods, or multi-state sales tax nexus).

3. Editorial Independence & How We Keep Tools Free

All 20 interactive calculators and 10 playbooks are 100% free with zero signup walls or paywalled results. To fund ongoing maintenance and hosting, ShopMarginLab earns revenue from two clearly disclosed sources: (1) optional digital Excel/Google Sheets templates on Gumroad, and (2) clearly labeled affiliate links (marked rel="sponsored") for seller tools like Shopify, Printify, and Link My Books.

Strict Math Independence: No affiliate partner can pay to alter a fee rate, hide a subscription cost, or manipulate ranking order inside our 7-Channel Live Fee Comparison. Read our full FTC Affiliate Disclosure & Terms.
